cases.name: vscode
cases.graphProvenance: Existing editor-exported graph at integrations/continue/risk-concern.exported.json; labelled input.
cases.profileIsolation: Dedicated child HOME/config/data directories; no real user memory used; provider/credential environment names omitted.

commands.block:
terraphim-agent --format json memory capture \
  --content 'Risk requires a Decision: approve a second supplier as the mitigation.' \
  --provenance-tag 'public-project-brief' > captured-memory.json
memory_id="$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("captured-memory.json"))["memory_id"])')"
terraphim-agent memory show "$memory_id" --json

cases.baseline: Zero passages with explicit empty graph; one Risk passage with existing editor export.

cases.name: continue
cases.graphProvenance: Existing editor-exported graph at integrations/continue/risk-concern.exported.json; labelled input.
cases.profileIsolation: Dedicated child HOME/config/data directories; no real user memory used; provider/credential environment names omitted.

commands.block:
mkdir briefs
printf '%s\n' 'Risk: supplier delays require a backup plan.' > briefs/decision.md
terraphim-grep concern --search-only --haystack all \
  --paths ./briefs --thesaurus ./risk-concern.exported.json --json -n 3

terraphim-agent --format json memory capture \
  --content 'Risk requires a Decision: approve a second supplier as the mitigation.' \
  --provenance-tag 'public-project-brief' > captured-memory.json
memory_id="$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("captured-memory.json"))["memory_id"])')"
terraphim-agent memory show "$memory_id" --json

cases.baseline: Zero passages with explicit empty graph; one Risk passage with existing editor export.

scope: Exact new README shell blocks executed with released binaries in fresh child-only local profiles. The graph is an existing editor export supplied as labelled input; these CLI runs do not claim a new editor operation or provider synthesis.
